Hello Everyone ❤️
I just need some clarifications... Quick background about us 👇🏻

I'm a Filipina married to an Israeli citizen. We're living in Beersheva. We got married last Feb 11, 2026. Filed our application online last Feb 27, 2026. 

I had my valid working B1 visa (caregiver) until March 30, 2026 and automatically extended of 3 months due to the war, therefore, until June 30, 2026. This is accdg. to the agency that I've worked with before and to the lawyer who married us... 

The MH Beersheva answered our online application last June and asking for the additional requirements. We already complied to it. However, until now, we haven't receive any updates regarding our process... and obviously, my B1 visa is already expired. I sent an email requesting for appointment last month thru their website for the visa status. Yet, until now, no response. 

Any recommendations or ideas what to do please? Or shall we just wait until the MH sent us another email or call us?. Or shall I go their without scheduled appoinment, if yes? Which day is the best day to go? 

Thank you everyone in advance. 🙏🏻
